column4: \tランス城、参謀本部によったランス
column5: Rance Castle, Rance stopped by the staff headquarters.

column4: \t戦略画面を見ながら・・うーん、兵士がたらん
column5: Looking at the strategic map... hmm, there aren't enough soldiers.

column4: \t各国、混乱状態の中、正規軍だけでにく予備役も動員して
column5: In all countries, amid chaos, not only the regular army but also the reserves have been mobilized.

column4: \t最大限の兵数で戦っています。
column5: They are fighting with the maximum number of troops.

column4: \tなお、この数は軍事作戦に参加している直接部隊の兵士の数である
column5: Note, this number counts soldiers in the direct units participating in military operations.

column4: \t各地の守備兵や、後方を支える部隊などの数は入っていません
column5: It does not include the number of garrison troops or support units in the rear.

column4: \t実際にはこの５倍からの人達が・・
column5: Actually, there are about five times as many people as this...

column4: \tえーい、ややこしいのはいい、実際に作戦に使える部隊数が必要なのだ。
column5: Damn it, complicated stuff aside, we need the actual number of troops we can use in the operation.

column4: \tどんどん減っているじゃないか、増員かけてないのか？
column5: The numbers are steadily decreasing, aren't you recruiting more?
It's a crisis for the whole world!

column4: \tもちろん、各国全力で増員をしているのですが、それ以上に死傷者数が多く
column5: Of course, every country is recruiting at full force, but the casualties exceed that number,

column4: \t補充が追いつかずに減っている一方に見えてしまうのです
column5: so it just looks like the numbers are decreasing because reinforcements can't keep up.

column4: \tよし、俺様がいっちょ声をかけて集めてくるぞ。
column5: Alright, I'll go and call out to gather some troops myself.

column4: \t俺が魔人を倒しきる前に全滅しては困るからな。
column5: It'd be a problem if you all got wiped out before I finish off the Fiend.
